# mk

The Go port of `src/markers.ts`, generated by [go-anything](https://github.com/xiaobingan/go-anything).

    go get github.com/xiaobingan/go-anything/testdata/markers/go-ports/markers-go

Every export the bridge carries: `half`, `divide`, `negativeZero`, `keep`, `loneSurrogate`, `undefinedValue`, `isNegativeZero`.

The recorded cases live next to the crate; `go-anything gate` says whether this build still
answers all of them.
